Find a Class

What We Do

Our yoga teachers are passionate about creating a brave space in our yoga studios. Allowing our students to comfortably practice and experiment with yoga.

Group Classes

We offer a range of yoga classes, from beginners yoga to aerial yoga. Each yoga class offers a unique experience, allowing you to deepen your practice, increase your awareness and connect with fellow yogis.

Private Classes

Enjoy the benefits of your own private yoga instructor, with our private classes. Whether you're just starting out or looking to advance your practice, our teachers would love to help.

Events and Workshops

Allow us to curate a unique yogic event to suit your needs. Our events and workshops are carefully created to share the benefits of yoga.

What is Yoga?

The word Yoga comes from the Sanskrit word “Yuj” meaning to yoke, bind, join, attached and union.

It is the connection of the body, mind and spirit.

We form this connection through our breath and our asana practice (the practice of yoga postures).

The more we practice, the more we build an awareness of this connection.

the intention behind asana tribe

We are Asana Tribe, you and I.

Individuals here on this earth, navigating it as best we can. We use the ancient practice of Yoga and Meditation to move through the layers of our well-being. We transcend through the physical, mental, and emotional.

our yoga teachers

Our yoga instructors are dedicated to helping you create a deeper connection with your body, mind and soul. Sabrina, Kathryn and Mel are passionate about yoga and sharing the practice with like-minded people.
